article.headline: Alfred Worrell Jr. scores 27 as Morgan State beats Cheyney (PA) 103-52
article.description: — Alfred Worrell Jr. scored 27 points as Morgan State got its season underway Monday with a 103-52 victory over Cheyney (PA).
article.linkText: Alfred Worrell Jr. scores 27 as Morgan State beats Cheyney (PA) 103-52
article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Alfred Worrell Jr. scored 27 points as Morgan State got its season underway Monday with a 103-52 victory over Cheyney (PA). Worrell added five rebounds for the Bears. Keith Richards scored 15 points and added nine assists. Trent Edwards went 4 for 6 from the field to finish with 10 points. Steven Hill led the Wolves with 10 points. Paul Lindsay II added 10 points for Cheyney (PA). S.J. Hutchinson II finished with nine points. Up next Morgan State hosts Virginia-Lynchburg on Wednesday, and Cheyney (PA) visits Maryland-Eastern Shore on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
